title: Longitudinal Outcomes of Bilateral and Unilateral Proximal Greater Occipital Nerve Pulsed Radiofrequency in Migraine: A Prospective Randomized Controlled Trial
excluded: Months 1/3 and overall longitudinal effects not specific to month 6
VAS, HIT-6, MIDAS, GPE and safety
population_or_material: The article-defined per-protocol population completing follow-up in the migraine GON-PRF trial.
requested_items: Baseline/month-six arm MHD/AMD medians/IQR, month-six responder proportions/test, month-six absolute-score comparisons and explicitly reported month-six between-group MHD-reduction comparison. Attach within-arm tests to summaries; exclude baseline hypothesis tests, other visits and other migraine outcomes.
